subject: Insurance
title: Germany's Autobahn and Insurance
description: A fast breakdown of Germany's Autobahn and Insurance for builders.

hook.text: Germany has no speed limit on parts of the Autobahn. Yet auto insurance is CHEAPER than in the US.

buildup.text: Getting a German driver's license costs $2,000+ and requires 14 theory classes, 12 driving lessons.

discovery.text: Germany uses a bonus-malus system. Claim-free years earn discounts; claims increase your 'malus' class.

twist.text: Annual inspections (TÜV) are mandatory and strict. Unsafe cars don't reach the road.

climax.text: Germany proves that strict training, vehicle inspections, and merit-based pricing can make fast roads safer.

punchline.text: No speed limit, cheaper insurance. Germany trades education for speed safely.

quiz.question: Why is German auto insurance cheaper despite having no speed limits?
options: Rigorous driver training, inspections, and merit-based pricing
